rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something that cannot be done or happen.

example.traditional: 呢個要求根本冇可能嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jiu1 kau4 gan1 bun2 mou5 ho2 nang4 ge3

rows.note: Use this for a person or situation that is extremely difficult or frustrating to deal with.

example.english: Your client is really impossible to deal with.
example.jyutping: nei5 go3 haak3 zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 gaau2
